note: Boss 7 is a full implementation project; its deliverables are shown as steps.

walk.title: Boss 7: Kora goes live

steps.say: The boss project: take Kora Properties from spreadsheets to a live CRM, in four phases and ten deliverables. Every lesson in this track feeds one of them.
Phase one. Requirements: the process map with leaks, MoSCoW priorities, the data audit, success measures, and a dated yearly cost.
Then the solution design: objects, data dictionary, pipelines with exit rules, teams, permissions and assignment rules.
Phase two. Build the design in a sandbox, and prove the permission matrix with two test users.
Migrate at least two thousand messy rows: mapping sheet, cleaning workflow, rejects with reasons, test loads, and a reconciliation log.
Phase three. Automations: routing on every branch, the re-route timer, follow-ups and the stuck-deal alert, all tested with test records.
Integrations: the upsert sub-workflow, website form, portal parser, WhatsApp acknowledgement and the Paystack deposit in test mode.
Phase four. UAT scripts for every must, defect lists, a training plan and three short training videos.
Dashboards for agents, managers and the owner, a weighted forecast, and a four-week adoption report with actions.
The implementation agent: read-only tools, plans with a dry run and hash, Telegram approval, and its first monthly health report.
Finally the handover pack and a five-minute demo: a portal enquiry owned in minutes, a deposit moving a deal, and one approved plan applied.

walk.end: That's Kora live. Build each deliverable, then show the demo end to end.
